target.approvedName: NHL repeat containing E3 ubiquitin protein ligase 1
functionDescriptions: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase. Together with the phosphatase EPM2A/laforin, appears to be involved in the clearance of toxic polyglucosan and protein aggregates via multiple pathways. In complex with EPM2A/laforin and HSP70, suppresses the cellular toxicity of misfolded proteins by promoting their degradation through the ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS). Ubiquitinates the glycogen-targeting protein phosphatase subunits PPP1R3C/PTG and PPP1R3D in a laforin- dependent manner and targets them for proteasome-dependent degradation, thus decreasing glycogen accumulation. Polyubiquitinates EPM2A/laforin and ubiquitinates AGL and targets them for proteasome-dependent degradation. Also promotes proteasome-independent protein degradation through the macroautophagy pathway. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:15930137, ECO:0000269|PubMed:17908927, ECO:0000269|PubMed:18070875, ECO:0000269|PubMed:19036738, ECO:0000269|PubMed:21505799, ECO:0000269|PubMed:23624058}.
